title: Which 2D operation loses the canvas
blurb: Twenty trials, each doing one thing that the pages which lost their canvases on a phone have in common. Each starts on a press. The result of every trial is stored before and after it runs, so a tab that dies names the trial that was running.
question: Which single 2D canvas operation, run alone, loses the canvas or the tab on a phone?
result: On Chrome 159 for Android, a drawable 2D canvas made with willReadFrequently, drawn into and read once, lost every 2D canvas on the page every half second. Ten other operations did not. In Chromium 157 with software rendering no trial loses a canvas.
